data.title: Fatima tones it down
data.description: Opera in Thai is a challenging prospect. In addition to handling the aspects of choosing a librettist, creating an effective operatic structure and writing for that most finicky of instruments, the human voice, a composer has to deal with the Thai language.

data.title: Dems say 'no' to debate without vote
data.description: The Democrat Party has ruled out a separate parliamentary debate without a vote under Section 152, saying the opposition should focus on its planned no-confidence motion.

data.title: First-half blitz in HK earns Rabbits their first victory
data.description: BG Pathum United claimed their first win of their AFC Champions League Two campaign when they defeated Tai Po 3-0 at Mong Kok Stadium in Hong Kong on Thursday night.

data.title: Govt plans 'nightlife sandbox' for Khao San, Rambuttri
data.description: The government plans to introduce a sandbox scheme covering Khao San and Rambuttri roads in Bangkok to improve law enforcement at entertainment venues and prevent corruption among state officials.

data.title: Lifetime driving licences 'won't be binned'
data.description: The Department of Land Transport (DLT) has dismissed social media reports that it plans to cancel or confiscate lifetime driving licences, insisting that existing holders can continue using them legally.

data.title: Govt braces for US-Iran fallout
data.description: The National Security Council (NSC) will convene an urgent meeting on Wednesday to review national preparedness measures amid growing concerns over the situation in the Middle East.

data.title: Influencer seeks foundation probe
data.description: A Facebook influencer has filed a police complaint seeking an investigation into the Good Deeds Foundation over allegations that it used public donations for purposes unrelated to its charitable objectives.

data.title: Trump, Milei under pressure to explain Bolsonaro flight from Brazil
data.description: BRASíLIA - US President Donald Trump and Argentina's Javier Milei faced mounting pressure Friday to explain the role their countries played in helping Flavio Bolsonaro flee Brazil after he had his passports cancelled.

data.title: Polish riot police deployed after court chief suspended
data.description: WARSAW - Riot police deployed around Poland's constitutional court and President Karol Nawrocki called off an African visit on Friday after the suspension of its chief justice in a battle between the centrist government and the nationalist right.

data.title: France fears new street violence at Halloween protests
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Shops and businesses in Paris and other French cities on Friday boarded up windows amid fears of fresh street violence during a third consecutive weekend of protests -- this time clashing with Halloween.

data.title: British king reflects on colonial atrocities in Guyana
data.description: GEORGETOWN (GUYANA) - Britain's King Charles paid homage to fallen soldiers and reflected on colonial atrocities in Guyana during a whistle-stop tour of the former colony on Friday.

data.title: Monaco taken off global money-laundering 'grey list'
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Global anti-money laundering watchdog the Financial Action Task Force (FATF) said Friday it had removed Monaco and three other countries from its "grey list", two years after it put the principality among its territories requiring increased monitoring.

data.title: Scottish police probe Andrew, Epstein stay at royal castle: UK media
data.description: LONDON - Scottish police are in the "very early stage" of probing the late US sex offender Jeffrey Epstein's reported stay at the royal Balmoral estate at the invitation of ex-prince Andrew, UK media reported Friday.

data.title: Puripol proud as NOCT honours sprinter
data.description: Sprinter Puripol Boonson expressed his deep sense of pride after he was honoured by the National Olympic Committee of Thailand (NOCT) during a special ceremony on Thursday.

data.title: Buriram left waiting for first ACL Elite win
data.description: Thai League 1 champions Buriram United were kept waiting for their first win in the AFC Champions League Elite after a 1-1 draw at Japan’s Gamba Osaka on Wednesday night.

data.title: Tears, fear, anger: relatives of Spain train crash dead await fate
data.description: TOLEDO (SPAIN) - Marisa Liebana could barely hold back her tears as she sought news about her nephew Francisco Jose, one of the 69 victims of this week's high-speed rail crash in Spain.

data.title: UN nature talks in extra time as nations struggle to reach deal
data.description: YEREVAN - The UN biodiversity summit spilled into overtime Friday, pushing negotiations into the night as nations wrangled over how to get a landmark deal to halt nature's destruction back on track.

data.title: Traffic woes prompt calls for upgrades
data.description: Transport Minister Phiphat Ratchakitprakarn has ordered agencies to assess measures to ease Phuket’s traffic congestion and improve road safety following a meeting with local business leaders.

data.title: Smaller contractors say rooftop solar terms too strict
data.description: Smaller contractors risk being shut out of the government’s 50-billion-baht solar rooftop programme because of stringent requirements that could discourage them from participating, according to an industry group.

data.title: Thousands of students, workers hold peaceful protests in Italy
data.description: ROME - Thousands of students and workers took to the streets across Italy on Friday, calling for more school funding and relief from the soaring cost of living, in massive protests that remained mostly peaceful.

data.title: Luxury villa operator faces charges
data.description: PHUKET: Immigration police have arrested a Chinese woman accused of using Thai nominees to operate a luxury villa rental business worth more than 50 million baht.

data.description: Your spot-on weekly horoscope for work, money and relationships from Guru by Bangkok Post 's famously accurate fortune teller. Let's see how you will fare this week and beyond.

data.title: Vatican says Pope Leo voted in US midterm election
data.description: ROME - Pope Leo XIV, the first US-born leader of the Roman Catholic Church, has voted in the United States midterm elections, submitting his mail-in ballot in Chicago, the Vatican said on Friday.

data.title: US jury backs Bayer in weedkiller cancer case
data.description: A US jury has sided with the multinational company Bayer over three women’s claims its Roundup weedkiller caused their cancer, the latest blow to plaintiffs in thousands of similar cases.

data.title: High hopes Udon Thani horticulture expo will justify cost
data.description: UDON THANI - The International Horticultural Expo 2026, a 2.5-billion-baht investment, has been readied for public viewing with hopes it will stimulate the local economy and justify its considerable cost.

data.title: Jewish leader’s relatives, 19 firms under scrutiny after citizenship revoked
data.description: The Interior Ministry and the Department of Special Investigation (DSI) are examining the descendants of Jewish community leader Yosef Chaim Kantor and 19 companies linked to him after his Thai citizenship was revoked.

data.title: Charity boss suspended
data.description: The Good Deeds Foundation has temporarily suspended its president, actress Panadda “Bum” Wongphudee, and halted donations pending an investigation into financial transactions linked to the construction of its facilities in Pathum Thani.

data.title: Thailand ready to evacuate citizens if Mideast tensions escalate
data.description: Foreign Affairs Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow has reaffirmed Thailand’s readiness to respond to developments in the Middle East, saying preparations are under way to evacuate Thai nationals if necessary, amid reports that the United States may launch another military operation against Iran.

data.title: Land sought for fossil museum in Phetchabun
data.description: PHETCHABUN: Ban Phot Municipality is seeking permission to use 23 rai of agricultural reform land to develop an open-air museum at a fossil site located in Nong Phai district of this northern province.

data.title: PTTEP wins two awards at SET Awards 2026, reflecting excellence in innovation and investor relations
data.description: Ms. Kanita Sartwattayu, Chief Executive Officer of PTT Exploration and Production PublicCompany Limited (PTTEP), received two prestigious awards at the SET Awards 2026 from Mr. Asadej Kongsiri, President of the Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET). These accolades include the SET Award of Honor: Best Innovative Company, presented to PTTEP for the fifth consecutive year in recognition of its innovative “DigitalX,” which enhances operational efficiency across the entire exploration and production (E&P) value chain, and the Outstanding Investor Relations Awards, recognizing excellence in investor relations among listed companies with a market capitalization exceeding THB 100 billion.

data.title: Three Major Trade Shows to Watch in 2026!
data.description: Grand Master Exhibition Co., Ltd. , in collaboration with the Thailand Convention and Exhibition Bureau (TCEB), the Office of Small and Medium Enterprises Promotion (OSMEP), the Thai Advertising Business Development Association (TABDA), and the Thai Garment Manufacturers Association (TGMA), is gearing up to present three of the year's leading trade shows: Bangkok Ad & Sign Expo 2026, Bangkok Digital Textile Print Expo 2026 , and Bangkok Pack & Label Expo 2026.
